name: Open the newest case replay from the home page
description: Validates the home page (title, live recorder card, the two newest cases) and that a case card opens that case's replay console with its 3D view drawn.

planSteps.description: Assert the page heading reads "Ship traffic over subsea cables" and the live recorder card (data-testid recorder-status) is shown with a data-state of recording, failing, stale, never-ran or unreachable; unless it is unreachable, its ship count (data-testid recorder-ships) is a whole number
Assert the newest cases list (data-testid latest-cases) holds exactly 2 case cards, each a link whose data-testid starts with case-card-
Note the heading of the first case card and its data-testid (case-card-<slug>), then click that card

Assert the URL path is /cases/<slug> for the noted slug, the replay console (data-testid replay-console) is shown, and the case switcher button (data-testid case-switcher) reads the noted card heading
Then wait up to 60 seconds for the 3D view (data-testid seabed-view) to reach data-state "ready"
Assert no card saying "The 3D view did not load" is shown
